rotate_image_90_degrees: rotate an image by 90, 180, or 270 degrees using numpy transpose and slicing
compute_gradient_for_model: compute the gradient of a model output with respect to input images using TensorFlow GradientTape
compute_grads_for_rotations: compute gradients for an image across all four 90-degree rotations and inverse-rotate each gradient back
compute_grads_for_rotations_and_flips: compute gradients for all rotations and horizontal flips of an image and concatenate the results
review_interpretability_helpers: review the interpretability helpers module for gradient computation and image rotation functions
